title: Power verbs that make hiring managers look twice 👇🏻  #SHORTS
description:
Power verbs that make hiring managers look twice 

Manager experience:
Use  spearheaded, directed, oversaw, led, orchestrated

Collaborated on something:
Use  coordinated, partnered, aligned, contributed, supported cross-functional work

Worked as part of a team:
Use  engineered, developed, built, shaped, executed your part of the project

Helped with a project:
Use  accelerated, facilitated, enabled, improved, strengthened

Worked on tasks every day:
Use  executed, delivered, maintained, completed, managed workflows

Supported the team:
Use  enabled, assisted, reinforced, backed, contributed to team outcomes

“Responsible for…”:
Use  owned, drove, delivered, executed, managed
